description: This file defines the Operations class, which manages registration, retrieval, and listing of Operation objects within a calculator application. It acts as a registry for operations, providing methods to register new operations, reset the registry, retrieve operations by name, get the number of registered operations, and list operation names in sorted order.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a collection of Operation objects, allowing registration, retrieval, and listing of operations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new Operation object in the commands map, asserting that an operation with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all registered operations from the commands map.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves an Operation object by its name from the commands map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of registered operations.

methods.name: getOperationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation at the specified index after sorting the operation names.
